name: cc-present
description: cc-present: ad-hoc live web artifacts for Claude sessions — the agent composes an approval board, choice list, or rich-content page from typed blocks, you interact in a localhost web UI, and every click streams back into the session in realtime. Edits are never gated.

args:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
config = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or pathlib.Path.home() / ".claude")
installs = json.loads((config / "plugins" / "installed_plugins.json").read_text())["plugins"].get("cc-present@cc-present")
if not installs:
    raise SystemExit("cc-present: the cc-present@cc-present plugin is not installed")
newest = max(installs, key=lambda entry: entry.get("lastUpdated") or entry.get("installedAt") or "")
binary = str(pathlib.Path(newest["installPath"]) / "bin" / "cc-present")
subprocess.run([binary, "--version"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.execv(binary, [binary, *sys.argv[1:]])
